father.example_en: My father cooked noodles for us after the football match.
father.example_zh: 足球赛后，爸爸给我们煮了面条。

fault.example_en: The broken window was my fault after the ball game.
fault.example_zh: 球赛之后，那扇打破的窗户是我的过错。

favour.example_en: Helping classmates every day earned her the teacher's favour.
favour.example_zh: 她天天帮助同学，赢得了老师的好感。

fear.example_en: His fear of dogs kept him away from the park.
fear.example_zh: 他怕狗，所以一直远离那个公园。

feature.example_en: A stone bridge is the main feature of our town.
feature.example_zh: 一座石桥是我们小镇的主要特征。

February.example_en: The art show opens in February after the winter break.
February.example_zh: 艺术展在寒假结束之后的二月开幕。

fee.example_en: The zoo charges a small fee for students on weekends.
fee.example_zh: 动物园在周末向学生收取少量费用。

feedback.example_en: The coach gave me useful feedback after the race.
feedback.example_zh: 教练在比赛后给了我有用的反馈。

feeling.example_en: A warm feeling spread through me when I saw Dad.
feeling.example_zh: 见到爸爸时，一股温暖的感觉涌遍了全身。

fence.example_en: The dog squeezed through a gap in the garden fence.
fence.example_zh: 狗从花园篱笆的一个缺口钻了过去。

festival.example_en: The town lantern festival lit the river for three nights.
festival.example_zh: 镇上的灯节把河面照亮了三个晚上。

field.example_en: Cows were grazing in the field behind my uncle's farm.
field.example_zh: 牛在我叔叔农场后面的田野里吃草。

figure.example_en: Daily swimming slowly changed his figure over the summer.
figure.example_zh: 每天游泳让他的身形在那个夏天慢慢变了。

file.example_en: Dad copied the file onto a memory stick at home.
file.example_zh: 爸爸在家把文件复制到了存储盘上。

film.example_en: Our class saw a film about ocean life on Friday night.
film.example_zh: 我们班星期五晚上看了一部关于海洋生物的电影。

finance.example_en: City finance paid for the new school roof this spring.
finance.example_zh: 市里的财政今年春天支付了新校舍屋顶的费用。

finding.example_en: Her finding on bean plants surprised the science club.
finding.example_zh: 她关于豆苗的发现让科学社团吃了一惊。

finger.example_en: I burned my finger while frying eggs this morning.
finger.example_zh: 今天早上煎鸡蛋时，我烫伤了手指。

fire.example_en: Campers sat around a small fire after the sun set.
fire.example_zh: 露营的人日落后围坐在一小堆火旁边。

firm.example_en: My uncle's firm repairs phones in a shop near school.
firm.example_zh: 我叔叔的公司在学校附近的店里修手机。

fish.example_en: Mum steamed fish with ginger for dinner tonight.
fish.example_zh: 妈妈今晚用姜蒸了鱼当晚餐。

fishing.example_en: Grandpa took us fishing on the lake last Sunday.
fishing.example_zh: 爷爷上星期天带我们到湖上钓鱼。

flag.example_en: Children raised the flag before class began today.
flag.example_zh: 孩子们今天在上课前升起了旗帜。

flight.example_en: The eagle's flight over the valley looked calm and strong.
flight.example_zh: 鹰飞越山谷的飞行看起来平稳而有力。

floor.example_en: Soup spilled across the kitchen floor during dinner.
floor.example_zh: 晚饭时汤洒在了厨房的地板上。

flow.example_en: After the storm, the river's flow became fast and muddy.
flow.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，河水流动得又急又浑。

flower.example_en: She picked a yellow flower from the pot by the window.
flower.example_zh: 她从窗边的花盆里摘了一朵黄花。

flu.example_en: Ben stayed in bed with flu for the whole weekend.
flu.example_zh: 本因为流感在床上躺了整整一个周末。

fog.example_en: Thick fog covered the harbour when our ferry left.
fog.example_zh: 渡轮离开时，浓雾笼罩着港口。

folk.example_en: Village folk shared a big meal after the harvest.
folk.example_zh: 村里的人们在收获后一起吃了一顿丰盛的饭。

food.example_en: Hot food was waiting when we came in from the rain.
food.example_zh: 我们淋雨回来时，热饭已经摆好了。

foot.example_en: I twisted my foot on the stairs at the stadium.
foot.example_zh: 我在体育场的楼梯上扭伤了脚。

football.example_en: They kicked a football around the yard until sunset.
football.example_zh: 他们在院子里踢足球，一直踢到日落。

force.example_en: The rescue force set up tents after the earthquake.
force.example_zh: 救援部队在地震后搭起了帐篷。

forest.example_en: Pine trees fill the forest beyond the last bus stop.
forest.example_zh: 松树长满了末班车站那边的森林。

fork.example_en: I dropped my fork under the table during lunch.
fork.example_zh: 午饭时我的叉子掉到了桌子底下。

form.example_en: New students complete a form on their first morning.
form.example_zh: 新生在开学第一个早晨填写一张表格。

format.example_en: Teachers changed the format of the weekly spelling quiz.
format.example_zh: 老师改了每周拼写小测的格式。

fortnight.example_en: We visited Uncle for a fortnight during the summer holiday.
fortnight.example_zh: 暑假期间我们在叔叔家住了两星期。

forum.example_en: Parents left messages on the school forum about lunch.
forum.example_zh: 家长们在学校论坛上留言谈论午餐。

frame.example_en: The wooden frame around the class photo came loose.
frame.example_zh: 班级合影周围的木框松了。

framework.example_en: This framework for the report keeps my ideas in order.
framework.example_zh: 这个报告框架让我的思路保持清楚。

freedom.example_en: The holiday gave us freedom to explore the old town.
freedom.example_zh: 假期给了我们逛老城的自由。

freezer.example_en: Ice cream stays hard in the freezer beside the fridge.
freezer.example_zh: 冰淇淋在冰箱旁边的冰柜里还是硬的。

frequency.example_en: Bus frequency falls after nine on school nights.
frequency.example_zh: 上学日晚上九点以后，公交车的频率就下降了。

Friday.example_en: Choir practice moved to Friday because the hall was busy.
Friday.example_zh: 因为大厅有活动，合唱练习改到了星期五。

friend.example_en: My friend shared her umbrella with me in the rain.
friend.example_zh: 下雨时，朋友和我合撑一把伞。

frost.example_en: White frost covered the car windows before we left home.
frost.example_zh: 我们出门前，白霜覆盖了车窗。

fruit.example_en: Ripe fruit from the market filled two large bowls.
fruit.example_zh: 从市场买来的熟水果装满了两个大碗。

fuel.example_en: The truck could not leave because its fuel had run out.
fuel.example_zh: 卡车开不走了，因为它的燃料已经用完。

fun.example_en: Making dumplings together was great fun on New Year's Eve.
fun.example_zh: 除夕一起包饺子特别有乐趣。

function.example_en: We graphed a simple function on paper during maths.
function.example_zh: 数学课上我们在纸上画了一个简单的函数。

funding.example_en: Without funding, the drama club could not rent costumes.
funding.example_zh: 没有经费，戏剧社团就租不起服装。

future.example_en: She trains daily because her future is in nursing.
future.example_zh: 她每天训练，因为她的未来是做护理。

game.example_en: The board game kept us busy through a rainy afternoon.
game.example_zh: 那个桌游让我们在下雨的下午忙个不停。

gap.example_en: The gap in their maths scores closed after extra practice.
gap.example_zh: 额外练习之后，他们数学成绩的差距缩小了。

garage.example_en: Bikes and a spare tyre fill the garage behind the house.
garage.example_zh: 自行车和一只备用轮胎塞满了屋后的车库。

garden.example_en: Tomatoes are ripening in the garden beside the kitchen.
garden.example_zh: 西红柿正在厨房旁边的花园里渐渐成熟。

gas.example_en: I smelled gas and opened the kitchen windows at once.
gas.example_zh: 我闻到气体的味道，立刻打开了厨房的窗户。

gate.example_en: Parents waited outside the gate with coats and umbrellas.
gate.example_zh: 家长们拿着外套和雨伞在大门外等着。

gender.example_en: The application asks you to write your gender on line two.
gender.example_zh: 申请表要你在第二行写下性别。

Germany.example_en: My aunt teaches violin at a college in Germany.
Germany.example_zh: 我姑姑在德国一所学院教小提琴。

girl.example_en: A girl from Class Two won the city reading prize.
girl.example_zh: 二班的一个女孩获得了全市阅读奖。

glass.example_en: He knocked over a glass of juice at breakfast.
glass.example_zh: 早饭时他打翻了一杯果汁。

goal.example_en: Maya kicked the final goal just as the whistle blew.
goal.example_zh: 哨声响起时，玛雅踢进了最后一球。

god.example_en: In that myth, a god sends rain to the dry valley.
god.example_zh: 在那个神话里，一位神把雨送到干旱的山谷。

gold.example_en: Visitors can still see gold in the old mine museum.
gold.example_zh: 游客仍能在旧矿博物馆里看到黄金。

government.example_en: The government opened a free clinic near the market.
government.example_zh: 政府在市场附近开了一家免费诊所。

grade.example_en: He entered a higher grade after passing the summer test.
grade.example_zh: 他通过暑假测验后升入了更高的年级。

graduate.example_en: A recent graduate came back to coach our debate team.
graduate.example_zh: 一位刚毕业的学生回来指导我们的辩论队。

granddad.example_en: My granddad showed me how to mend a flat tyre.
granddad.example_zh: 爷爷教我怎么补撒了气的轮胎。

grandma.example_en: Grandma packed dumplings for our early train this morning.
grandma.example_zh: 奶奶今天早上为我们的早班火车包了饺子。

grass.example_en: Dew on the grass soaked my shoes before sunrise.
grass.example_zh: 日出前，草上的露水打湿了我的鞋。

Greece.example_en: We climbed white steps above the sea in Greece.
Greece.example_zh: 我们在希腊爬上海边的白色石阶。

ground.example_en: Apples lay on the ground under the tree after the strong wind.
ground.example_zh: 大风过后，苹果落在了树下的地面上。

group.example_en: Our project group met in the library after lunch.
group.example_zh: 我们的项目组午饭后在图书馆碰面。

growth.example_en: Warm weather quickened the growth of the beans we planted.
growth.example_zh: 暖和的天气让我们种的豆子长得更快。

guidance.example_en: I asked my coach for guidance before the final match.
guidance.example_zh: 决赛前我向教练请教指引。

guidelines.example_en: Safety guidelines require helmets on the cycling trip.
guidelines.example_zh: 安全指引要求这次骑行必须戴头盔。

guitar.example_en: Leo practised the guitar in his room until bedtime.
guitar.example_zh: 利奥在自己房间里练吉他，一直练到睡觉。

gum.example_en: The teacher asked us not to chew gum in class.
gum.example_zh: 老师叫我们上课时不要嚼口香糖。

gun.example_en: His toy gun snapped when it hit the stone floor.
gun.example_zh: 他的玩具枪砸到石地板上，断了。

guy.example_en: A guy on the train helped me lift the heavy box.
guy.example_zh: 火车上一个家伙帮我抬起了那个重箱子。

habit.example_en: Leaving shoes by the door became a habit in our flat.
habit.example_zh: 把鞋放在门口成了我们家的习惯。

hair.example_en: Wind tangled her hair on the walk to the station.
hair.example_zh: 走到车站的路上，风吹乱了她的头发。

hairdresser.example_en: The hairdresser trimmed my fringe before the school photo.
hairdresser.example_zh: 学校拍照前，理发师给我修了刘海。

half.example_en: Half of the sandwiches were eaten before the picnic started.
half.example_zh: 野餐还没开始，三明治就被吃掉了一半。

hall.example_en: Speeches and songs filled the hall on prize day.
hall.example_zh: 颁奖那天，大厅里满是演讲和歌声。

ham.example_en: She wrapped cheese in ham for the party snacks.
ham.example_zh: 她用火腿裹上奶酪，当作聚会的小吃。

hand.example_en: Paint covered his hand after the art lesson ended.
hand.example_zh: 美术课结束后，他满手都是颜料。

hardware.example_en: New hardware arrived for the computer room on Monday.
hardware.example_zh: 星期一，电脑室到了一批新硬件。

hat.example_en: My hat landed in a puddle when the wind rose.
hat.example_zh: 风大起来时，我的帽子掉进了水坑。

head.example_en: She bumped her head on the low bunk at camp.
head.example_zh: 她在营地的矮床上碰了头。

health.example_en: Daily walks improved his health after the long illness.
health.example_zh: 久病之后，每天散步让他的健康好了起来。

hearing.example_en: Earplugs protected his hearing at the loud concert.
hearing.example_zh: 耳塞在喧闹的音乐会上保护了他的听力。

heart.example_en: Her heart raced as she waited for the exam results.
heart.example_zh: 她等考试成绩时，心脏跳得飞快。

heat.example_en: Afternoon heat drove us into the shaded courtyard.
heat.example_zh: 午后的热把我们赶进了阴凉的院子。

heater.example_en: The small heater warmed the bedroom within a few minutes.
heater.example_zh: 小加热器几分钟就把卧室烘暖了。

heating.example_en: Central heating keeps the classrooms warm through winter.
heating.example_zh: 集中供暖让教室整个冬天都保持暖和。

heaven.example_en: Grandma told us kind people go to heaven after they die.
heaven.example_zh: 奶奶告诉我们，善良的人死后会上天堂。

height.example_en: Extra height helped her block shots in basketball.
height.example_zh: 身高优势帮她在篮球赛里封盖投篮。

hell.example_en: The picture shows hell as a pit of fire and smoke.
hell.example_zh: 这幅画把地狱画成一个充满火与烟的深坑。

hero.example_en: Neighbours called her a hero after she stopped the fire.
hero.example_zh: 她把火扑灭之后，邻居们称她为英雄。

hill.example_en: We pushed our bikes up the steep hill outside town.
hill.example_zh: 我们推着自行车爬上镇外那座陡峭的小山。

history.example_en: History club meets in room twelve on Wednesday afternoons.
history.example_zh: 历史社团星期三下午在十二号教室活动。

holder.example_en: Each pass holder may enter the museum without paying.
holder.example_zh: 每位通行证持有人都可以免费进入博物馆。

hole.example_en: A hole in the tent let rain drip onto my sleeping bag.
hole.example_zh: 帐篷上有个洞，雨水滴到了我的睡袋上。

Holland.example_en: Windmills still turn in the flat fields of Holland.
Holland.example_zh: 荷兰平坦的田野上，风车仍在转动。

home.example_en: The rain started just as we reached home from practice.
home.example_zh: 我们训练完刚到家，雨就下起来了。

honey.example_en: She spooned honey over warm bread at breakfast time.
honey.example_zh: 早饭时她把蜂蜜舀到热面包上。

honour.example_en: Carrying the flag was an honour for the whole class.

horse.example_en: A tired horse drank from the bucket beside the stable.
horse.example_zh: 一匹疲惫的马在马厩旁边的桶里喝水。

hospital.example_en: The ambulance took him to hospital after the match.
hospital.example_zh: 比赛结束后，救护车把他送去了医院。

hotel.example_en: Our hotel room faced the sea and smelled of salt.
hotel.example_zh: 我们的旅馆房间面向大海，有咸咸的味道。

hour.example_en: Homework took an hour after I got back from chess club.
hour.example_zh: 我从象棋社团回来后，作业花了一个小时。

house.example_en: Smoke rose from the house at the end of our street.
house.example_zh: 烟从我们这条街尽头的房子里冒了出来。

housing.example_en: Student housing near the campus fills up before September.
housing.example_zh: 校园附近的学生住房在九月前就住满了。

husband.example_en: Her husband met the children at the school gate.
husband.example_zh: 她丈夫在学校大门口接孩子。

ice.example_en: Thin ice covered the pond, so we stayed on the path.
ice.example_zh: 池塘结了薄冰，所以我们只走小路。

idea.example_en: Sam had an idea for fixing the broken classroom clock.
idea.example_zh: 萨姆想到一个办法来修坏掉的教室时钟。

idiot.example_en: I felt like an idiot for leaving the tickets on the bus.
idiot.example_zh: 我把票落在公交车上，觉得自己像个白痴。

illness.example_en: A stomach illness kept Nora home during the school play.
illness.example_zh: 一场胃病让诺拉在学校演出期间待在家里。

illustration.example_en: This illustration shows how blood moves through the heart.
illustration.example_zh: 这幅插图展示血液怎样流过心脏。

image.example_en: A blurry image of the moon filled the telescope screen.
image.example_zh: 一幅模糊的月亮图像占满了望远镜的屏幕。

imagination.example_en: With a little imagination, the cardboard became a spaceship.
imagination.example_zh: 只要有一点想象力，纸板就变成了宇宙飞船。

implementation.example_en: Full implementation of the recycling plan begins next month.
implementation.example_zh: 回收计划的全面实施从下个月开始。

implication.example_en: His silence had the implication that the plan had failed.
implication.example_zh: 他的沉默暗示这个计划已经失败了。

importance.example_en: Mum stressed the importance of breakfast before a test.
importance.example_zh: 妈妈强调了考试前吃早餐的重要性。

impression.example_en: The museum left a deep impression on my little sister.
impression.example_zh: 博物馆给我妹妹留下了深刻的印象。

improvement.example_en: Steady improvement showed in his handwriting this month.
improvement.example_zh: 这个月他的字迹有了稳步的进步。

inch.example_en: The puddle grew an inch deeper after the noon storm.
inch.example_zh: 中午的暴风雨过后，水坑又深了一英寸。

incident.example_en: A minor incident in the hallway delayed the fire drill.
incident.example_zh: 走廊里的一件小事耽误了消防演习。

income.example_en: Extra income from weekend work pays for his art supplies.
income.example_zh: 周末打工的额外收入用来买他的美术用品。

independence.example_en: The parade marks independence with flags along the main street.
independence.example_zh: 游行用主街两旁的旗帜纪念独立。

index.example_en: Use the index to locate the chapter on volcanoes.
index.example_zh: 用索引就能找到讲火山的那一章。

indication.example_en: Falling leaves were an indication that autumn had arrived.
indication.example_zh: 落叶是秋天已经到来的迹象。

indicator.example_en: Attendance is a useful indicator of how the class is coping.
indicator.example_zh: 出勤率是一个有用的指标，可以看出班级适应得如何。

industry.example_en: Shipbuilding is still a major industry along this coast.
industry.example_zh: 造船仍然是这片海岸的重要工业。

infection.example_en: A skin infection kept him out of the swimming pool.
infection.example_zh: 皮肤感染让他不能去游泳池。

information.example_en: This leaflet gives information about bus routes to the museum.
information.example_zh: 这张传单提供了去博物馆的公交路线信息。

initiative.example_en: She took the initiative and booked the room for our meeting.
initiative.example_zh: 她采取主动行动，为我们的会议订好了房间。

input.example_en: Wrong input from the keyboard ruined the saved document.
input.example_zh: 键盘输入错误，毁掉了已经保存的文档。

insight.example_en: Living on the farm gave me insight into how crops grow.
insight.example_zh: 住在农场让我明白了庄稼是怎么生长的。

inspection.example_en: Health inspection closed the snack bar for two days.
inspection.example_zh: 卫生查验让小吃店停业了两天。

installation.example_en: Installation of the smart board took the whole afternoon.
installation.example_zh: 智能白板的安装花了整整一个下午。

instance.example_en: This delay is one instance of buses running late in snow.
instance.example_zh: 这次晚点就是公交车在雪天误点的一个例子。

institution.example_en: The weekly assembly is an institution at our school now.
institution.example_zh: 每周的集会现在已经成了我们学校的一项制度。

instruction.example_en: Follow the instruction on the packet before you bake.
instruction.example_zh: 烘烤前先按照包装上的说明去做。

instrument.example_en: She carried her instrument onto the stage in a soft case.
instrument.example_zh: 她把乐器放在软盒里拿上了舞台。

insurance.example_en: Bike insurance paid for a new wheel after the crash.
insurance.example_zh: 自行车保险在事故后赔了一只新车轮。

intelligence.example_en: Solving riddles together tested our intelligence and our patience.
intelligence.example_zh: 一起猜谜既考验了我们的智力，也考验了耐心。

intention.example_en: My intention was to return the book before the library closed.
intention.example_zh: 我的用意是在图书馆关门前把书还回去。

interaction.example_en: Real interaction started when we swapped roles in the scene.
interaction.example_zh: 我们在场景里交换角色后，真正的互动才开始。

interest.example_en: His interest in birds started after a trip to the wetlands.
interest.example_zh: 一次湿地之行之后，他对鸟类产生了兴趣。

Internet.example_en: She checked the Internet for the museum's opening hours.
Internet.example_zh: 她在互联网上查了博物馆的开放时间。

interpretation.example_en: Her interpretation helped visitors understand the mayor's speech.
interpretation.example_zh: 她的翻译帮助来宾听懂了市长的讲话。

interval.example_en: People stretched during the interval before the second act.
interval.example_zh: 第二幕开始前的间隔时间里，人们伸了伸懒腰。

interview.example_en: Job interview nerves made her voice shake at first.
interview.example_zh: 求职面试让她紧张，声音一开始都在发抖。

introduction.example_en: A short introduction explains who the characters are.
introduction.example_zh: 一段简短的介绍说明了这些人物是谁。

investigation.example_en: An investigation began after money went missing from the office.
investigation.example_zh: 办公室的钱不见了之后，调查就开始了。

investment.example_en: Their investment in the bakery paid off within a year.
investment.example_zh: 他们对面包店的投资在一年内有了回报。

involvement.example_en: Parent involvement made the sports day run more smoothly.
involvement.example_zh: 家长的参与让运动会进行得更顺利。

Iran.example_en: Saffron from Iran scented the rice at the food stall.
Iran.example_zh: 食摊上的米饭带着从伊朗带来的藏红花香味。

Ireland.example_en: Stone walls divide the green fields across Ireland.
Ireland.example_zh: 石墙把爱尔兰的绿色田野一块块分开。

iron.example_en: The old mill gate was made of rusty iron.
iron.example_zh: 磨坊的旧大门是用生锈的铁做成的。

Islam.example_en: Families at the mosque practise Islam in their daily lives.
Islam.example_zh: 清真寺的那些家庭在日常生活中信仰伊斯兰教。

Israel.example_en: Cousins in Israel sent dates and photos for the holiday.
Israel.example_zh: 以色列的表亲为节日寄来了椰枣和照片。

issue.example_en: Litter has become an issue around the bus station.
issue.example_zh: 垃圾已经成了公交车站一带的问题。

Italy.example_en: We ate lemon ice cream on a warm evening in Italy.
Italy.example_zh: 我们在意大利一个暖和的晚上吃了柠檬冰淇淋。

item.example_en: One item on the list was sold out by noon.
item.example_zh: 清单上有一项到中午就卖光了。

jacket.example_en: Mud splashed my jacket when the bus passed a puddle.
jacket.example_zh: 公交车经过水坑时，泥点溅到了我的夹克上。

January.example_en: Ice on the playground lasted through January this year.
January.example_zh: 今年操场上的冰一直留到了一月底。

Japan.example_en: Cherry trees were in bloom when we landed in Japan.
Japan.example_zh: 我们降落在日本时，樱花正在开放。

jar.example_en: Jam filled the jar that Grandma sealed last summer.
jar.example_zh: 果酱装满了奶奶去年夏天封好的广口瓶。

jeans.example_en: Muddy jeans dried on the line behind the house.
jeans.example_zh: 沾了泥的牛仔裤在屋后的绳子上晾干了。

Jesus.example_en: A painting of Jesus hangs above the church door.
Jesus.example_zh: 一幅耶稣的画像挂在教堂大门的上方。

Jew.example_en: The diary describes how a Jew hid during the war.
Jew.example_zh: 这本日记描述了一位犹太人怎样在战争中躲藏。

job.example_en: A weekend job at the bookshop helps her save for college.
job.example_zh: 她周末在书店打工，好攒上大学的钱。

joke.example_en: That joke about the lost cat made even the driver laugh.
joke.example_zh: 那个关于走失的猫的笑话连司机都逗笑了。

Jordan.example_en: Letters from Jordan arrived with photos of the desert.
Jordan.example_zh: 从约旦寄来的信里夹着沙漠的照片。

journal.example_en: She filled her journal with notes about yesterday's storm.
journal.example_zh: 她在日志里记下了昨天的暴风雨。

journey.example_en: Our journey over the mountains took two full days.
journey.example_zh: 我们翻山的旅程花了整整两天。

joy.example_en: Pure joy showed on his face when the puppy arrived.
joy.example_zh: 小狗到的时候，他脸上满是喜悦。

judgement.example_en: Calm judgement helped the captain steer through the storm.
judgement.example_zh: 冷静的判断帮助船长驶过了风暴。

juice.example_en: Apple juice stained the white cloth on the picnic table.
juice.example_zh: 苹果汁弄脏了野餐桌上的白桌布。

July.example_en: Street markets stay open late in July because of the heat.
July.example_zh: 因为天热，街市在七月会开到很晚。

jumper.example_en: The wool in that jumper itched my neck all afternoon.
jumper.example_zh: 那件套头衫的羊毛扎得我脖子痒了一下午。

June.example_en: School reports go home in June before the holiday begins.
June.example_zh: 成绩单在假期开始前的六月发回家。

justice.example_en: The judge's decision brought justice for the injured driver.
justice.example_zh: 法官的判决为受伤的司机带来了正义。

kettle.example_en: The kettle sang on the stove while toast browned.
kettle.example_zh: 面包烤黄的时候，水壶在炉子上响了起来。

kid.example_en: The kid across the hall lent me a spare pencil.
kid.example_zh: 走廊对面的小孩借给我一支备用铅笔。

king.example_en: In the play, the king loses his crown in the forest.
king.example_zh: 在这出戏里，国王把王冠丢在了森林里。

kit.example_en: Dad used a repair kit from the boot to fix the flat tyre.
kit.example_zh: 爸爸用后备箱里的成套工具修好了瘪胎。
